panel.denominator_correction: The V3-001 proposal gate said normal 8/8, but the fixed jb-000+jb2-009 composition contains exactly 4 normal items; denominators are corrected to the actual panel BEFORE any generation or review

generation: Trained reader+branch loaded from ckpt-050 with digest checks vs the train report. Per position: fresh full-prefix base frame from the frozen reference/prefix path; trained branch residual computed in torch; C continuous forward with the residual injected must match torch logits within atol 1e-5 rtol 1e-4 with identical top-1 (per-position parity gate); wrapper commit uses the same token; 24-token budget; EOS/UTF-8/truncation recorded as in DG-023.

gates.protocol: 24/24 replies generated with all per-position C parity checks passing; determinism spot-check on 2 records
gates.binding: gates are judged on the AGGREGATE of two fresh isolated blind reviewers using DG-023 packet v2 projection; disagreements recorded; no threshold change after seeing replies

limits: 24-item smoke panel on two frozen worlds; outcome attributes supervision-completion-50-steps vs prior CG failures on THIS panel only; not LoCoMo, not deployment, not P2 sign-off
stop: Failures kept with full replies; if protocol parity fails the round stops and reports the numeric divergence; no re-runs with different seeds
